-----Original Message-----
From: Elena ICC, PE <chartering@elenaicc.ks.ua> 
Sent: Thursday, 7 May 2026 12:36
To: management <management@etm-services.net>
Subject: Cargoes from Ukraine and Moldova

FM :'ELENA IND. & COMM.CO.', PE
FAX/PH : +380666370399
                +380674932903
E-MAIL : admin@pkf-elena.com
               chartering@pkf-elena.com
               chartering@elenaicc.ks.ua - new!
WEBSITE: www.pkf-elena.com , www.elenaicc.ks.ua - new!

07.05.2026       12:35:37

Giurgiuleshti - EC Greece
3000 mts of corn, sf 51-52, wog
L/c: from 15.05.2026
L/d: 1000/1000
Brok. comm. 1.25

Reni - Marmara or Izmir, in ch's op.
need vessel with 250000 cub.ft. (+/-) for scrap cargo (but may try any vessel's intake)
L/c: spot
L/d: 500/1000
Brok. comm. 1.25

Chornomorsk - Poti
3000-3500 mts of sugar in bb (dims: LxBxH: 120x100x110cm, UW: abt 1,0 tns)
L/c: 02-07.06.2026
L/d: 5 ttl days / 5 ttl days shex
Brok. comm. 2.5
(Pref. open hatch/ box shaped , IACS or equiv., no tiers limitations)

POC - Douala, Cameroon
25000-30000 mts of milling wheat, sf 48-49, wog
L/c: first half of May, 2026
L/d: 6000/2500
(self unloading cranes (grabs available at disch. port); 8.5 m max draft at Douala, Cameroon) Brok. comm. 1.25

BRGDS,
'ELENA IND. & COMM.CO.'

We kindly invite you to visit our NEW web-site: www.elenaicc.ks.ua Ми запрошуємо Вас відвідати наш новий сайт: www.elenaicc.ks.ua
